description:
Hushfacebook v0.7.2 targets Facebook 581.0.0.45.58 (com.facebook.katana), the newest release, and 580.0.0.51.74 and 577.0.0.50.72 still work.

This release gathers everything since v0.7.1 and brings 70 patches, up from 60. Every Marketplace seller gets View profile, reels can keep playing in a picture-in-picture window, and new switches turn off HDR brightness, haptics and screen transitions. Tabs can be hidden one at a time, Instant Games ads and analytics uploads are held back, and phones with a 32-bit processor on Android 11 or newer can patch 581 too.

Validation: 1796 runtime tests passed locally. All 746 patch tests passed too, along with both Android lints. All 70 patches applied to Facebook 581.0.0.45.58, 580.0.0.51.74 and 577.0.0.50.72, and the resource and injected-code checks passed.

Review diagnostic reports for private data before sharing them.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.34.0 or newer. Patch the arm64-v8a, Android 11+ bundle of Facebook 581.0.0.45.58, build 475215365, or its 32-bit build 475215364. Builds 580.0.0.51.74 (475019344) and 577.0.0.50.72 (474426275) still work. The .mpp is a patch bundle, not a Facebook APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
